name: [forge] Playback evidence sustained 5xx
query: logs("service:forge-web env:prod \"event=recommendation.evidence\" (\"action=playback\" OR \"action=context\" OR \"action=claim\" OR \"action=facts\") (\"httpStatus=500\" OR \"httpStatus=502\" OR \"httpStatus=503\" OR \"httpStatus=504\")").index("*").rollup("count").last("5m") >= 5
message:
Investigate normalized reasons and upstream/acknowledgement timeouts. Compare complete HTTP request numerator and denominator; the production canary requires under 1%, not merely a quiet count alert.

Runbook: docs/operations/recommendation-evidence-transport.md. Configure the approved notification destination before installation.
